import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

WEST, SOUTH, EAST, NORTH = -10.0, 35.0, 32.0, 60.0
img = np.array(Image.open("/tmp/icon_front_v1/case_03_very_far/comparison/eumetsat_geocolour.png"))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7,7), dpi=110)
ax.imshow(img, extent=(WEST, EAST, SOUTH, NORTH), origin="upper", aspect="auto")

ellipse = patches.Ellipse((11.5, 47.5), width=9, height=7, fill=False, edgecolor="lime", linewidth=3)
ax.add_patch(ellipse)
ax.annotate("имел в виду ЭТУ дугу", (11.5, 47.5), xytext=(11.5, 54),
            color="lime", fontsize=11, ha="center", weight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="lime", linewidth=2))

ellipse2 = patches.Ellipse((20, 41.5), width=8, height=11, fill=False, edgecolor="cyan", linewidth=3, linestyle="--")
ax.add_patch(ellipse2)
ax.annotate("твой круг (горы)", (20, 36.2), xytext=(20, 36.2),
            color="cyan", fontsize=11, ha="center", weight="bold")

ax.set_xlim(WEST, EAST); ax.set_ylim(SOUTH, NORTH)
ax.set_title("Чистый GeoColour — где какая дуга", fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlabel("lon"); ax.set_ylabel("lat")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("/tmp/icon_front_v1/annotated_clean.png", dpi=110)
print("saved")
'
